H8300.def: from «08277»; a survivor:--X alive, left, remain(- ing), remnant, rest.

H8301.def: the same as «08300»; Sarid, a place in Palestine:--Sarid.

H8302.et: from (08281) in the original sense of turning
H8302.def: or shiryon {shir-yone'}; and shiryan {shir- yawn'}; also (feminine) shiryah {shir-yaw'}; and shiryonah {shir-yo-naw'}; from «08281» in the original sense of turning; a corslet (as if twisted):--breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See «05630».

H8303.et: the same as (08302) (ie sheeted with snow)
H8303.def: and Siryon {sir-yone'}; the same as «08304» (i.e. sheeted with snow); Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon:--Sirion.

H8304.def: or Srayahuw {ser-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «08280» and «03050»; Jah has prevailed; Serajah, the name of nine Israelites:--Seraiah.

H8305.et: from the same as (08321) in the original sense of piercing
H8305.def: from the same as «08321» in the original sense of piercing; hetchelling (or combing flax), i.e. (concretely) tow (by extension, linen cloth):--fine.

H8306.et: from (08324) in the original sense as in (08270) (compare (08326))
H8306.def: from «08324» in the original sense as in «08270» (compare «08326»); a cord, i.e. (by analogy) sinew:--navel.

H8307.et: from (08324) in the sense of twisted, i.e. firm
H8307.def: from «08324» in the sense of twisted, i.e. firm; obstinacy:--imagination, lust.

H8309.et: probably by an orthographical error for (07709)
H8309.def: probably by an orthographical error for «07709»; a common:--field.

H8310.def: of foreign derivation; Sarsekim, a Babylonian general:--Sarsechim.

H8311.def: a primitive root; to prolong, i.e. (reflex) be deformed by excess of members:--stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing.

H8313.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, set) on fire:--(cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, × utterly.

H8314.def: from «08313»; burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color):--fiery (serpent), seraph.

H8315.def: the same as «08314»; Saraph, an Israelite:--Saraph.

H8317.def: a primitive root; to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound:--breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.

H8318.def: from «08317»; a swarm, i.e. active mass of minute animals:--creep(-ing thing), move(-ing creature).

H8319.def: a primitive root; properly, to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn):--hiss.

H8320.def: from «08319»; bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay:--speckled. See «08291».

H8321.et: from (08319) in the sense of redness (compare (08320))
H8321.def: or sowreq {so-rake'}; and (feminine) soreqah {so- ray-kaw'}; from «08319» in the sense of redness (compare «08320»); a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety):--choice(-st, noble) wine. Compare «08291».

H8323.def: a primitive root; to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion:--X altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.

H8324.def: a primitive root; to be hostile (only active participle an opponent):--enemy.

H8326.et: from (08324) in the sense of twisting (compare (08270))
H8326.def: from «08324» in the sense of twisting (compare «08270»); the umbilical cord, i.e. (by extension) a bodice:--navel.

H8327.def: a primitive root; to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it:--(take, cause to take) root (out).

H8328.def: from «08327»; a root (literally or figuratively):--bottom, deep, heel, root.

H8329.def: the same as «08328»; Sheresh, an Israelite:--Sharesh.

H8331.def: from «08327»; a chain (as rooted, i.e. linked):--chain. Compare «08333».

H8332.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «08327»; eradication, i.e. (figuratively) exile:--banishment.

H8333.def: from «08327» (compare «08331»); a chain; (arch.) probably a garland:--chain.

H8334.def: a primitive root; to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to:--minister (unto), (do) serve(- ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.

H8336.def: or (for alliteration with «04897») shshiy {shesh-ee'}; for «07893»; bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble:--X blue, fine ((twined)) linen, marble, silk.

H8337.def: masculine shishshah {shish-shaw'}; a primitive number; six (as an overplus (see «07797») beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth:--six((-teen, -teenth)), sixth.

H8338.def: a primitive root; apparently, to annihilate:--leave by the sixth part (by confusion with «08341»).

H8339.def: of foreign derivation; Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name:--Sheshbazzar.

H8341.def: a denominative from «08337»; to sixth or divide into sixths:--give the sixth participle

H8342.def: or sason {saw-sone'}; from «07797»; cheerfulness; specifically, welcome:--gladness, joy, mirth, rejoicing.

H8343.def: perhaps from «08336»; whitish; Shashai, an Israelite:--Shashai.

H8347.def: of foreign derivation; Sheshak, a symbol. name of Babylon:--Sheshach.

H8348.def: perhaps for «07799»; lily; Sheshan, an Israelite:--Sheshan.

H8349.def: probably from the base of «07785»; pedestrian; Shashak, an Israelite:--Shashak.

H8350.et: perhaps from the base of (08324) in the sense of that of (08320)
H8350.def: perhaps from the base of «08324» in the sense of that of «08320»; red ochre (from its piercing color):--vermillion.

H8352.def: from «07896»; put, i.e. substituted; Sheth, third son of Adam:--Seth, Sheth.

H8354.def: a primitive root; to imbibe (literally or figuratively):--X assuredly, banquet, × certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk (X -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of «08248».)

H8356.def: from «07896»; a basis, i.e. (figuratively) political or moral support:--foundation, purpose.

H8359.def: from «07896»; a fixture, i.e. the warp in weaving:--warp.

H8363.def: from «08362»; a sprig (as if transplanted), i.e. sucker:--plant.

H8364.def: patronymically from «07803»; a Shuthalchite (collectively) or descendants of Shuthelach:--Shuthalhites.

H8365.def: a primitive root; to unveil (figuratively):--be open.

H8366.def: a primitive root; (causatively) to make water, i.e. urinate:--piss.

H8367.def: a primitive root; to subside:--be calm, cease, be quiet.

H8368.def: a primitive root; to break out (as an eruption):--have in (one's) secret parts.

H8369.def: of foreign derivation; Shethar, a Persian satrap:--Shethar.

H8370.def: of foreign derivation; Shethar-Bozenai, a Persian officer:--Shethar-boznai.

H8371.def: a primitive root; to place, i.e. array; reflex. to lie:--be laid, set.

H8372.def: and (feminine) ta ah (Ezek. 40:12) {taw-aw'}; from (the base of) «08376»; a room (as circumscribed):--(little) chamber.

H8374.et: a primitive root [probably identical with (08373) through the idea of puffing disdainfully at
H8374.def: a primitive root (probably identical with «08373» through the idea of puffing disdainfully at; compare «0340»); to loathe (morally):--abhor.

H8376.def: a primitive root; to mark off, i.e. (intensively) designate:--point out.

H8377.def: and towt (the original form) {toh}; from «08376»; a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek):--wild bull (ox).

H8378.def: from «0183» (abbreviated); a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm):--dainty, desire, × exceedingly, × greedily, lust(ing), pleasant. See also «06914».

H8379.def: from «08376»; a limit, i.e. full extent:--utmost bound.

H8380.def: or taom {taw-ome'}; from «08382»; a twin (in plural only), literally or figuratively:--twins.

H8382.def: a primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from «08380», to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (arch.) jointed:--coupled (together), bear twins.

H8384.def: or (in the singular, feminine) t:enah {teh-ay- naw'}; perhaps of foreign derivation; the fig (tree or fruit):--fig (tree).

H8385.def: or tonanah {to-an-aw'}; from «0579»; an opportunity or (subjectively) purpose:--occasion.

H8387.def: from «08385» and «07887»; approach of Shiloh; Taanath-Shiloh, a place in Palestine:--Taanath-shiloh.

H8388.def: a primitive root; to delineate; reflex. to extend:--be drawn, mark out, (Rimmon-)methoar (by union with «07417»).

H8389.def: from «08388»; outline, i.e. figure or appearance:--+ beautiful, × comely, countenance, + fair, × favoured, form, × goodly, × resemble, visage.

H8390.def: perhaps from «0772»; Taarea, an Israelite:--Tarea. See «08475».

H8391.def: from «0833»; a species of cedar (from its erectness):--box (tree).

H8392.def: perhaps of foreign derivation; a box:--ark.

H8393.def: from «0935»; income, i.e. produce (literally or figuratively):--fruit, gain, increase, revenue.

H8394.def: and (feminine) tbuwnah {teb-oo-naw'}; or towbunah {to-boo-naw'}; from «0995»; intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice:--discretion, reason, skilfulness, understanding, wisdom.

H8395.def: from «0947»; a treading down, i.e. ruin:--destruction.

H8396.def: from a root corresponding to «08406»; broken region; Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent:--Tabor.

H8397.def: apparently from «01101»; mixture, i.e. unnatural bestiality:--confusion.

H8398.def: from «02986»; the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a partic. land, as Babylonia, Palestine:--habitable part, world.
